collections.name: Dragon Priest masks
collections.blurb: Masks of the ancient Dragon Priests. Collecting the eight from Skyrim's dragon priests unlocks Konahrik; Solstheim has four more.

items.name: Hevnoraak
items.where: Hevnoraak is an iron dragon priest mask gained by killing Hevnoraak within the Nordic Ruin of Valthume. The enchantment provides poison and disease immunity for all diseases and poisons except for one

items.name: Krosis
items.where: Krosis is a bronze dragon priest mask gained by killing the eponymous Krosis upon Shearpoint, a dragon lair. The mask's enchantment improves the user's Alchemy, Archery, and Lockpicking skills by twen

items.name: Morokei
items.where: Morokei is a moonstone dragon priest mask gained by killing Morokei within Labyrinthian. The mask's enchantment doubles magicka regeneration.

items.name: Nahkriin
items.where: Nahkriin is an ebony dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Nahkriin, who is encountered during the main quest at Skuldafn. It is imbued with an enchantment that grants the wearer a Fort

items.name: Otar
items.where: Otar is a malachite dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Otar the Mad within the Nordic ruin, Ragnvald. The artifact's enchantment grants 30 points of shock, fire, and frost resistance

items.name: Rahgot
items.where: Rahgot is an orichalcum dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Rahgot within the Nordic ruin, Forelhost. The artifact's enchantment increases your stamina by 70 points.

items.name: Vokun
items.where: Vokun is a steel dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Vokun within High Gate Ruins. The artifact's enchantments increase your Alteration, Conjuration, and Illusion skills by twenty poi

items.name: Volsung
items.where: Volsung is a corundum dragon priest mask obtained by killing the eponymous Volsung at the end of the Nordic ruin, Volskygge. The artifact's enchantment allows you to breathe underwater, carry an addit

items.name: Wooden Mask
items.where: The Wooden Mask is a dragon priest mask found in the exterior of Labyrinthian inside what was a perfectly round but is now a ruined building. It is alongside a long-forgotten note, the Hired Thug's Mi

items.name: Konahrik
items.where: Placed on the shrine in Bromjunaar Sanctuary once you hold the other eight Skyrim masks (the Wooden Mask opens the way).

items.name: Ahzidal
items.where: Ahzidal is the mask of the eponymous dragon priest, found within Kolbjorn Barrow. It gives the wearer a constant increase in fire damage by 25%, as well as 50% fire resistance.

items.name: Dukaan
items.where: Dukaan is the mask of the eponymous dragon priest, found within White Ridge Sanctum. It gives the wearer a constant increase in frost damage by 25%, as well as 50% frost resistance.

items.name: Zahkriisos
items.where: Zahkriisos is the mask of the eponymous dragon priest, found within Raven Rock Mine. It gives the wearer a constant increase in shock damage by 25%, as well as 50% shock resistance.

items.name: Miraak
items.where: Miraak is a mask worn by the dragon priest of the same name. There are six versions available to you.

items.where: Hall of the Dead (Whiterun). Inside the Catacombs; go down the left stairs and it will be to your left, next to a skeleton.

items.where: Dragonsreach, the Jarl's bedroom, on the right-hand end table.

items.where: Jorrvaskr's living quarters, on the bookshelf in Kodlak's room.

items.name: Stone 10: Markarth
items.where: Understone Keep's Dwemer Museum, on a table in the first room to the left.

items.name: Stone 11: College of Winterhold
items.where: Arch-Mage's Quarters. Access may be gained at the end of the quest Under Saarthal.

items.where: On the stone altar opposite the Word Wall.

items.where: On the table with two bodies in front of the Word Wall.

items.name: Stone 20: Yngvild
items.where: The gem is in the bedroom behind the throne in Yngvild Throne room.

items.name: Stone 21: Hob's Fall Cave
items.where: The gem is near the alchemy set under the bridge in the northwestern part of the cave system.

items.name: Stone 22: Reeking Cave or Thalmor Embassy
items.where:

items.where: Head down to the basement and press the hidden button to the right of the bookcase, providing access to the bandit's hideout. The gem is found in a locked room in the Bandit's Sanctuary.

items.name: Stone 24: Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary
items.where: On the dresser in Astrid's room. It is still accessible after the Death Incarnate quest; however, the game may freeze when you try to enter the Sanctuary after completing that quest.
